evidence.C1: tank is drawn as a glass box with depth haze and fish shadows, and journal/garden use field-guide plates, but some cards still feel generic.
evidence.C2: Flick up on the water, or press Cast is clear, but the phone fishing fight stacks tension, strength, line out, drag, and reel tightly.
evidence.C3: Breeding with inherited colours; aquascaping; greenhouse trays; reef lab; orders; journal; focus form many loops, though some are less visible in the screenshots.
evidence.C4: consistent white cards, pill buttons, and icons, but phone fishing controls and desktop side column density show rough edges.

fixes: Rework the phone fishing fight layout so tension, fish strength, line out, drag, and reel are grouped into a clearer, less cramped control panel.
Reduce density and improve hierarchy in the desktop tank side column by separating water status, care, and orders with clearer headings, spacing, and next-step affordances.
Surface breeding, reef genetics, and order loops in the main UI with visible entry points and cross-links so the described depth is as clear as the tank, fishing, and garden screens.

evidence.C1: Distinctive field-guide aesthetic with numbered plates, dotted ledger lines, glass-box tank perspective, receding gravel floor, depth haze; warm cream palette is coherent and no purple. Fish illustrations themselves are simple vector shapes compared to the detailed environment art, preventing a 10.
evidence.C2: Clear tool labels (Feed, Care, Scape, Residents, Shop, Photo, Watch, Share), helpful 'Tap a fish to meet it, or tap the glass' prompt, 'More to do' cards guide next steps, fishing instructions explicit ('Flick up on the water, or press Cast'). However, 8 tools on the tank screen is a lot to scan, and on phone they wrap to two rows of 4 which still feels busy.
evidence.C3: Many interlocking loops clearly exceeding a typical cozy aquarium: nitrogen cycle care, 9-spot fishing with flick/strike/reel/tension/drag, breeding with inherited colours, aquascaping (16 plants, 8 hardscape, 3 substrates, 3 tank sizes, reef room), greenhouse with variegated sports, reef lab with named strains, journal dex with silhouettes, focus timer with box breathing, offline catch-up. 47 species, 5 rarities, 12 quests, tournaments.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, floating cards with layered shadows, coherent warm palette across all screens, field-guide styling maintained. Feedback tooltips well-placed ('It is running. Let it take line'). Minor crowding on phone where tools row sits directly below tank; desktop side column is spacious but phone equivalent stacks tightly.

fixes: Reduce visual load of the 8-tool row on the Tank screen by grouping into primary/secondary tiers or collapsing less-used tools (Photo, Watch, Share) into a menu, especially on phone where it wraps to two rows.

Increase the detail and distinctiveness of the 47 fish illustrations to match the quality of the environment art (stones, driftwood, greenhouse bays) — currently fish are simple shapes while the tank art around them is richly rendered.

Make the 'More to do' guidance more prominent for first-time players — currently it sits in the side column below the water status; consider surfacing it as an onboarding overlay or empty-state callout so new players immediately see the next step (Go fishing, Greenhouse and reef lab, Field journal).

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette and serif type; 'side cards read like a field guide (numbered plates I and II... dotted ledger lines)'; per-species fish forms and glasshouse bays are distinctive. Not a 10: tank water is a flat teal with simple ray overlays and fish remain basic vector shapes, so the tank is pleasant but not yet unmistakably the hero; desktop fishing/tank leave large empty bands.
evidence.C2: Next-step guidance everywhere: 'Tap a fish to meet it, or tap the glass.', 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast', numbered 'How the greenhouse works' 1-4 strip, journal hints 'Try Blackwater river - fresh', arrow links like 'Harvest a ready tray above'. Not a 10: jargon tools 'Scape' and 'Watch' have no first-time explanation on the tools row.
evidence.C3: All anchor loops present and interlocked: 'nitrogen cycle simulation', flick/reel fishing with 'tournaments against CPU anglers', 'breeding with inherited colours', 'reef lab (frag, cross, named strains)', orders ('No. 1 Deliver 3 Rotala cuttings'), '18 milestones', focus timer. Not a 10: breeding, reef lab and scaping are asserted in text but visible in no screenshot, so the interlocking depth is only partly verifiable.
evidence.C4: Consistent pills, cards and icon style; clear states ('Empty tray' with seed packet, disabled 'Deliver', selected 'Medium' drag, active nav pill); unobtrusive toast 'Unlocked: Mountain stream, Mangrove inlet and 5 more'. Rough edges: 'No. 1' in garden orders vs 'No. 01' in journal, and the Cast button floats detached below the fishing scene card.

fixes: Push the tank art to hero level: richer water depth gradient/caustics and more detailed fish rendering so the tank reads as crafted art on both breakpoints (biggest C1 lever, w=0.30).
Tidy desktop composition: attach the Cast button to the fishing scene card and balance the empty band under the tank tools row so every desktop screen feels fully designed (C1/C4).
Surface the breeding and reef-lab loops from the tank screen (e.g. a 'More to do' or Residents entry) and unify micro-conventions ('No. 1' vs 'No. 01', one-line hints for 'Scape'/'Watch') (C3/C4).
